# Multiplayer Marbles, Reimagined

Jump into the classic game of marbles in extended reality!  Compete in fun and competitive matches with your friends and make new ones from around the world.  With skill, strategy, and precision, prove you’ve got what it takes to rule the **MRBLS** arena!
